terms.definition: A large language model wrapped in a loop that observes an environment, chooses one action per step, and repeats until the task is judged done or a limit is reached.
OpenHands' collection of more than 10 implemented agents that share the same platform and tool interfaces.
OpenHands' general-purpose agent that represents actions as executable code rather than a fixed action schema.
OpenHands' agent specialized for web-browser interaction tasks.
The fraction of SWE-Bench-style repository issues for which the agent's patch passes the issue's held-out test suite.
Whether the agent is given zero or one full worked demonstration of the task before attempting it.
An evaluation where the agent may attempt and revise a fix across several turns before its final answer is judged.
